Happy New Year everyone!

notes.title: Planets Update - Soft Launch 🪐
notes.content:
Hi everyone! 

Today's update is coming with an interesting new feature - the Planets system - in a very early state (there will be a lot more to come with it).

The Planets system introduces one-off, short runs you can go on to quickly retrieve a few seeds and plants.

To interact with the Planets system, simply jump in your scout ship and fly over to one of the planets in your immediate vicinity to get farming. When you drop into a Planet, you'll be immediately granted 10 random powers. Do your best to survive the run duration and return to your ship with your haul.

This feature has *a lot* more planned with it, but since it was ready and working, I wanted to get this early version into everyone's hands.

For a full list of what's new in this update, see the list below:
[list]
[*] Soft-Launch for the new Planets feature
[*] Improvements to SFX managements to prevent audio issues when you have lots of area powers
[*] Rebalancing of the Audio Logs spawn rates
[*] Increased spawn rates for chests during runs
[/list]

[img]https://i.imgur.com/XXBazgC.png[/img]

Enjoy 🌱

notes.title: Mini Voyager Update for Star Farmer: Warlock of the Universe
notes.content:
With Bullet Heaven Fest upon us, the Mini Voyager Update is now live with everything in from the month since launch:

[list]
[*] Mini Bosses from Planet 10 onward at every difficulty
[*] New Powers
[*] Collectables in Space to find
[*] Planet Modifiers added (each planet has a 50% chance to receive a modifier. Modifiers can include things like more or less enemies, more treasure, more obstacles, etc.)
[*] Rest Areas added to Planet 10 (these recover your health once you reach them)
[*] A big optimisation pass that should see significant performance improvements for some players (this also includes a major change with a new toon-style shader now used for the game)
[*] New Collectables to find
[*] New Buddies to collect
[/list]

Enjoy! 🌱

notes.title: One Month Since Launch!
notes.content:
It has now just hit one month since the launch of Star Farmer: Warlock of the Universe!

In the month since launch, I've been focusing on delivering updates to Star Farmer that improve some optimisation and balance issues, as well as addressing a few bugs. But, I did manage to sneak in a few new furniture items for you to collect and new buddies for you to find! 

As for what's next, Star Farmer will be part of a celebration of all things reverse bullet hell on Steam from November 6-20 - the Bullet Heaven Fest - and it's live in less than 2 weeks! So, get ready for hordes of enemies 💥

I have an update planned to release a little bit prior to the Bullet Heaven Fest kicking off too.

In the meantime, thank you so much to everyone for your support and for playing Star Farmer. And I look forward to getting you some new content soon! 🌱

notes.title: Star Farmer Has A Release Date!
notes.content:
Hello! I am very excited to announce that Star Farmer: Warlock of the Universe is very nearly ready for release ːsteamhappyː 

And with that, I'm pleased to say that the full game will be [b]live on the 28th of September[/b]: that's less than 3 weeks from now! 

Thank you to everyone who has wishlisted and/or followed the journey of Star Farmer's development, I'm very excited for you all to play the full version.

But, in the meantime, there is a [b]Prologue that you can play right now[/b] so please dive in and get familiar with Star Farmer ahead of the full release (your save data will transfer across to the full game).

[b]Grab it on Steam from here: [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2563140/Star_Farmer_Prologue/]Star Farmer: Prologue[/url].
[/b]
Thanks everyone and happy star farming!

Tyler
Tinker Town
